title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer (Melbourne land development)
content_text: Breese Pitt Dixon is a Hawthorn East civil engineering, surveying and planning firm that has worked on Melbourne land development for more than 40 years, designing major estates and infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads. Careers page: We don't advertise individual vacancies here. If you'd like to explore a career with Breese Pitt Dixon, email us an introduction with your CV and a short note on the kind of work you're looking for. Email your expression of interest to info@bpd.com.au Who we're looking for includes Graduate and experienced civil engineers and Draftspersons.
apply_instructions: No individual vacancies advertised. Careers page asks for an emailed introduction with CV and a short note to info@bpd.com.au.
